input.content: You are an independent PLC verification engineer. Return ONLY a JSON list of test cases.

You are an independent PLC test engineer. Generate comprehensive unit test cases for the specified PLC function block.
CODESYS Simulation Timing & Edge Rules:
- dt_ms advances elapsed PLC scan time for that step; TON/TOF timers accumulate dt_ms across consecutive steps while IN keeps its active state (e.g., IN=TRUE for TON).
- Rising-edge detection (R_TRIG or x AND NOT prev_x) requires a step with x=FALSE before the step with x=TRUE.

Return a JSON array of test case objects. Each test case must have:
- id: string identifier (e.g. 'case_1')
- steps: array of steps, where each step has:
    - inputs: dictionary of input variable names and values
    - expected: dictionary of expected output variable names and values
    - dt_ms: (optional) cycle elapsed time in milliseconds

TASK SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF008",
  "title": "Consecutive scan qualification with an immediate trip",
  "difficulty": "easy",
  "requirements": "# SELF008: Preset-Qualified Delay Counter\n\n## Background\nSequential delay counter validating integer `Preset` in `1..5` across continuous `Request` scans.\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `Request`, `Trip` (`BOOL`), `Preset` (`INT`, valid domain `1..5`).\n2. If `Request = FALSE`, `Trip = TRUE`, or `Preset` is outside `1..5`, reset `Count := 0` and set `Ready := FALSE`.\n3. Otherwise increment `Count := min(Count + 1, Preset)` and set `Ready := (Count >= Preset)`.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `Request: BOOL`, `Trip: BOOL`, `Preset: USINT`\n- **Outputs:** `Ready: BOOL`, `Count: USINT`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `Count=0`, `Ready=false`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\n`Preset` must be an integer (`bool` rejected); each qualifying scan counts as `1`.",
  "scenario": "A cyclic quality check accepts a request only after a configurable number of consecutive healthy invocations.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Request",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Raw qualification request"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Trip",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Immediate inhibit"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Preset",
      "type": "USINT",
      "description": "Required consecutive scans, valid 1 through 5"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Ready",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Qualified request"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Count",
      "type": "USINT",
      "description": "Saturated consecutive scan count"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "Count": 0,
    "Ready": false
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Trip, missing request and invalid Preset clear progress"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "Request": "I[k].Request: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Trip": "I[k].Trip: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Preset": "I[k].Preset: sampled input (USINT).",
    "Ready": "O[k].Ready: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Count": "O[k].Count: independently observed post-scan candidate value (USINT); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "invalid": "Preset < 1 or Preset > 5.",
    "qualified": "Count >= Preset and Preset is valid.",
    "qCount": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].Count\", \"initial\": 0, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Count; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "nextCount": "min(qCount+1, Preset) as an integer expression.",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Ready=false, O_init.Count=0."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF008.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF008.P1",
      "formula": "G((Trip | !Request | invalid) -> (!Ready & (Count = 0)))",
      "explanation": "Every interruption clears qualification immediately.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF008.P2",
      "formula": "G((Request & !Trip & !invalid) -> (Count = nextCount))",
      "explanation": "Healthy scans increment and saturate precisely.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF008.P3",
      "formula": "G(Ready <-> qualified)",
      "explanation": "The indication agrees with the post-scan count.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF008.P4",
      "formula": "G(!invalid -> ((Count >= 0) & (Count <= Preset)))",
      "explanation": "The counter stays within bounds.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF008.P5",
      "formula": "(G(Request & !Trip & !invalid)) -> F Ready",
      "explanation": "A perpetually valid request qualifies within at most five scans, even if valid Preset varies.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
Output budget: at most 2 cases, at most 8 steps per case. Use compact JSON. Cover a complete normal path and one important boundary. Keep reasoning concise enough to finish the entire JSON within the output budget.
